content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Repo: Moneo (Next.js 16 + React 19 + Supabase personal-finance app). Read AGENTS.md first and follow it: npm, simplest clean change, follow nearby patterns, one commit per logical step, run `npm test` and `npm run lint` (and `npm run build`, since this changes app UI) before opening the PR. This Next.js version differs from your training data, so check `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before relying on any API you're unsure of.

## Goal
Cards the chat proposes (pending rows in `agent_proposals` with `run_id is null`, status `proposed` or `failed`) must be reviewable on Overview (`app/page.tsx`), not only in the chat message that created them. Today:
- `iou_create` / `iou_settle` already show on Overview via `app/iou-review.tsx` (`IouReview`, "Loans to review", uses `openIouProposals` in `lib/ai/iou-proposals.ts` and `components/iou-card`).
- Detected `recurring_edit` cards show via `app/money/recurring/review.tsx` (`RecurringReview`, rendered right after `IouReview` in `app/page.tsx`).
- `transaction_create` (`lib/ai/transaction-proposals.ts`) and `balance_set` (`lib/ai/balance-proposals.ts`) cards appear ONLY in chat. That is the gap.

Note: `app/ai/iou-actions.ts` already loads/decides proposals of kinds `iou_create, iou_settle, transaction_create, balance_set, recurring_edit`, and for an open `transaction_create` it adds account options. Find the card component chat uses for transaction/balance cards and reuse it; don't build new accept/reject logic. Applying goes through `lib/ai/agent-apply.ts` as it does now.

## What to build
One Overview section, "Waiting for you", that **collapses/expands** (the user asked for a toggle). The collapsed header shows the count of open cards. Expanded, it lists every open standalone chat card: IOUs, transactions, balances, and chat-made recurring changes. Each card keeps its existing accept/dismiss/edit behavior, using the existing card components.
- Replace the separate "Loans to review" block on Overview with this section, so loans aren't listed twice. Keep `IouReview` wherever else it's used (e.g. `app/ai/agents/page.tsx`) unless you have a clean reason to change it.
- Look at how `RecurringReview` works (it also syncs detected suggestions). If folding its cards into the same section is simple and clean, do it; if not, leave it alone and say why in the PR.
- If you can do it cheaply, add small filter chips (All / Loans / Transactions / Balances / Recurring) inside the expanded section. Otherwise skip them.
- Hide the section when there are no open cards. Default to expanded when there are cards, unless the existing UI has a clear pattern for collapsed sections (look for one, e.g. agent run review groups).
- A future voice-note feature will create cards the same way, so make this section the single place all standalone open cards appear. No voice work now.
- Keep queries scoped by `workspace_id`, `run_id is null`, status `proposed`/`failed`, with a sensible limit, oldest or newest first to match existing patterns. Add the loader in `lib/ai/` next to similar ones and memoize it with `cache` like `loadIouReview`.

## Tests
Add or adjust Vitest tests next to the existing ones (e.g. `app/home-sections.test.tsx`, `lib/ai/iou-proposals.test.ts`-style) for the new loader and the section's render (hidden when empty; lists transaction and balance cards). If a gated Playwright flow exists for Overview, run it only if Supabase/auth is configured per `e2e/README.md`; otherwise say it was skipped.

## Deliver
Branch off the current commit, commit in small steps (end each commit message with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`), push, and open a PR against `main` with `gh pr create`. The PR body describes the change, the tests run and their results, and anything skipped; end it with `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`. Do not merge.

Your final line must be: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

git push -q -u origin feat/waiting-for-you 2>&1 | tail -3; cat > /tmp/pr-body.md <<'EOF'
## What changed
Overview now has one **Waiting for you** section. It collects every open card that isn't part of an agent run (`agent_proposals` rows for this workspace with `run_id is null` and status `proposed`/`failed`): loans and repayments, chat expenses and income, balance updates, and recurring changes from chat or from detection.

- **Loader:** `lib/ai/open-proposals.ts`, `openStandaloneProposals`. It returns cards oldest first, at most 100. Each transaction card also gets the accounts it can be paid from, the same way the chat card does. `STANDALONE_KINDS` is now the shared list of card kinds, and `app/ai/iou-actions.ts` uses it too. Future voice-note cards will show up here if they use one of these kinds.
- **Section:** `app/waiting-for-you.tsx`. `loadWaitingForYou` is memoized with `cache` like `loadIouReview`, and Home starts loading it early. The section is a native `<details>` element that starts expanded. Its header shows the count, e.g. "Waiting for you · 3". The section is hidden when nothing is open.
- **Filters:** All / Loans / Transactions / Balances / Recurring chips appear when more than one kind is open. Cards that don't match the filter are hidden but stay mounted, so a card you decide keeps its outcome when you change the filter.
- **Cards:** each card uses the existing `IouCard`, so accept, dismiss and choosing an account work as before and still go through `decideAgentProposals` and `lib/ai/agent-apply.ts`.
- **Overview:** the section replaces "Loans to review" (`IouReview`) and "Recurring to review" (`RecurringReview`). `IouReview` stays on the agent team page, and `RecurringReview` stays on `/money/recurring`.

### Recurring folded in
Folding recurring cards in was simple. The section's loader runs `syncRecurringProposals` first, as `RecurringReview` did, so detected cards are raised and stale ones closed before the list is read. If detection fails, the stored cards still show. Overview now also lists recurring cards made in chat; before, it only listed detected ones.

One cost: loan, expense and balance cards now wait for recurring detection before they appear, because everything is one list. The old recurring block already waited for the same detection on every Overview load.

## Tests
- New: `lib/ai/open-proposals.test.ts` checks the query filters (workspace, `run_id is null`, statuses, kinds, oldest first) and that transaction cards get account options while other cards are returned as stored.
- New: `app/waiting-for-you.test.tsx` checks that the section is hidden when empty, and that it renders open with the count, transaction and balance cards, account choices and the right chips.
- `npm test`: 207 files passed, 7 skipped (1039 tests passed, 9 skipped).
- `npm run lint`: clean.
- `npm run build`: passed.

## Skipped
- Gated Playwright for Overview (`e2e/home-dashboard.gated.spec.ts`, `core-journey`): not run. This worktree has no `.env`, so Supabase and auth aren't configured (see `e2e/README.md`).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF

I opened PR #118. Overview now has one **Waiting for you** section that lists every open card made outside an agent run: loans, transactions, balances and recurring changes. `npm test` (1039 passed, 9 skipped), `npm run lint` and `npm run build` all pass.

- **Section:** it's a native `<details>` that starts expanded, with a header like "Waiting for you · 3". It's hidden when nothing is open. I found no existing collapsed-section pattern to follow instead.
- **Filter chips:** All / Loans / Transactions / Balances / Recurring, shown only when more than one kind is open. Cards that don't match stay on the page but hidden, so a card you've already decided doesn't come back as open when you switch filters.
- **Cards:** each one uses the existing chat card component (`components/iou-card.tsx`), so accept, dismiss and the account picker work as before through `lib/ai/agent-apply.ts`.
- **Loader:** `lib/ai/open-proposals.ts` reads this workspace's cards with no run and status proposed or failed, oldest first, at most 100. Transaction cards also get their account choices. The list of card kinds is now shared with `app/ai/iou-actions.ts`.
- **Replaced on Overview:** "Loans to review" and "Recurring to review". They still appear on the agent team page and `/money/recurring`.

**Recurring cards:** I folded them in. The section runs recurring detection first, as the old recurring block did, so new detected cards appear and outdated ones are closed. Overview now also shows recurring changes made in chat, which it didn't before. The downside is that loan, transaction and balance cards now wait for detection to finish before they show, because it's all one list. The PR explains this.

**Not run:** the gated Overview Playwright flows. This worktree has no `.env`, so Supabase and auth aren't configured.
